name: NO_ENTRY_EMERGENCY_MAINTENANCE_VEHICLES_EXCEPTED_GATE_{gate}_WHITE_LONG
legend: NO ENTRY / EMERGENCY & MAINTENANCE VEHICLES EXCEPTED / GATE {gate}
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R2-SA101 900 x 600 (Transport SA, 2002, 1:10), R50, white, no outer border. Composite of three signs named on the sheet: R2-4A NO ENTRY (national spec's elements as they are: disc 440 dia at the 5 margin, x 5-445, y 5-445), R9-SA54A EMERGENCY & MAINTENANCE VEHICLES EXCEPTED fitted into 438 x 438 at x 456, y 6 (chain 5/440/11/438/6 across; the SA spec's layout scaled 438/450), and G6-SA101A GATE (its own sheet: 450 x 150, R25, 5 / 15, GATE 80 B ink 163 then 60 gap and an 80 B gate numeral, the pair centred, baseline 115) fitted into 440 x 140 at x 230, y 455 (chain 5/440/10/140/5 down, 230/440/230 across). Gate number varies: generated 1-5. The NO / ENTRY lines are centred on the disc (cx 225), not the 900 sign; the national R2-4 width figure for NO (116, 4 % under the font) is not re-checked here.
